newsitem.title: USA: FOMC to hold rates steady- Washington Post's Berry.
newsitem.headline: FOMC to hold rates steady- Washington Post's Berry.

text.p: Federal Reserve officials will most likely leave short-term interest rates unchanged at their upcoming policy-setting meeting, Washington Post staff writer John Berry wrote in the newspaper's Tuesday edition.

He added that Fed officials "remain a bit puzzled about why inflation and unemployment both remain so low" and that Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan has given no signals that he would raise rates to preempt an acceleration in inflation.
Last January, an article by Berry regarding Fed policy boosted U.S. Treasury security prices.
The FOMC is scheduled to begin talks around 0900 EDT/1300 GMT on Tuesday with a policy announcement expected around 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
